title: Global Newland U-Shaped Height-Adjustable Desk - 72"W x 95"D
body_html:
A full U-shaped command station that rises and falls at the touch of a button, pairing a sit-stand worksurface with a fixed credenza and pedestal storage.

The Newland NLP412 combines an L-shaped, 3-stage height-adjustable table with a matching credenza and pedestal in a 72"W x 95"D footprint. A dual-motor base glides from 22.6" to 48.2"H at 1.2" per second, with a digital controller, four memory positions, and an anti-collision sensor for safe, quiet operation. The 1" thermally fused laminate top is Made in Canada and available across the full Newland finish range, building for left- or right-hand layouts.

Key features

  • L-shaped height-adjustable table plus credenza with pedestal in a U-shaped footprint
  • 3-stage dual-motor base adjusts from 22.6" to 48.2"H at 1.2" per second
  • Up-down controller with digital read-out and four programmable memory positions
  • Anti-collision sensor and quiet 42 dB operation; standby draw just 0.1W
  • 1" thermally fused laminate top with 2 mm matching edge and leveling glides
  • Reversible build for left- or right-hand applications; quick assembly

Who it’s for

Private offices and executive workstations in municipal, education, and healthcare administration environments that need a sit-stand U-shaped command desk.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
